entries.note: Stored XSS in the profile flow, and swig autoescape disabled in server.js. Not one of the four classes. Not counted.
CSRF protection is commented out in server.js. Not counted.
ReDoS in the bank-routing regular expression in app/routes/profile.js. Not counted.
Helmet and related header hardening are commented out. Not counted.
Known-vulnerable Marked dependency. A dependency CVE is not one of the four classes. Not counted.
GET /learn redirects to req.query.url. That is an open redirect, not an outbound server fetch. Not counted as SSRF.
Tutorial A1 also describes log injection in routes/session.js. That is CWE-117, not SQL, NoSQL, command, or code injection. Not counted.
Password-policy and session-fixation notes in tutorial A2. Not authorization or IDOR. Not counted.
Tutorial A1 discusses child_process in general. No exec or spawn sink is present in the application source at this commit, so there is no command-injection label.
